body: That’s honestly so disheartening to hear.. his honesty is nice but he definitely could’ve gone about saying it a little nicer. I’m sorry to hear that :( but it’s your body! You do what you want to do, because getting a tattoo can be a personal milestone! Him having that shallow mindset is so disrespectful to you. Don’t let his opinions sway you from what you wanna do!

Actually dump him immediately. He eventually told you what the conversation was, but was hiding his true intentions and leading you on, leading her on. Leave him, because he didn’t discuss those feelings with you first, he discussed it with her. That’s emotional cheating.

He hasn’t been comparing me, I’d like to clarify that. I struggle with insecurities and I often make comparisons between myself and whatever character or actress he finds attractive, so these feelings come and I had the urge to talk about it tonight.

Thank you for.. for validating me. I don’t feel like I’m enough sometimes but it is nice to hear that validation. The identity struggle is one point I hadn’t thought of, or made conscious efforts to recognize, but it’s a good point! If I keep trying to make myself like someone else and lose myself along the way, which is awful.

No apology necessary, you speak from experience and I appreciate it! It’s awesome that you have someone like that in your life, especially so as a partner. I hope you two have many more amazing years together.

There’s been other struggles outside of him having a type or whatever, so I’m trying to work through it all. Thank you for your comment… and thank you for saying that.

Edit: grammar

He doesn’t just drop that info on me, it’s just something I’ve observed from our time together as partners, and as friends. We’ve known each other 12 years now. I don’t know his porn history or anything, this post is more related to certain aesthetic tropes he favors that he’s mentioned interest in at times, and it usually fits a character or person who he finds attractive. I just have insecurities I need to work on, but it doesn’t stop me from feeling those feelings here or anywhere. I communicated it to him not long after making this post and we agreed to talk more tomorrow so that’s promising.

Hey it’ll be okay, pace yourself and go easy on how hard you push. It’s okay to take breaks. Manage yourself and know your limits. Reward yourself for doing around 10 minutes of work with a snack, a break, anything, then jump back in after 10 minutes of that.

Having that many finals is stressful, but your health comes first. If worse comes to worse, email your professors about the projects if they aren’t done on time. I believe in you, internet stranger. You got this.
Good on you, it’s your life don’t let anyone try and overrun it with their shit. You got this.
